title: Guanine base modifications in antisense oligonucleotides mitigate acute central nervous system toxicity
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00316D, Paper
Open Access

Maho Katsuyama, Taiki Matsubayashi, Yang Ying, Su Su Lei Mon, Takayuki Kuroda, Kie Yoshida-Tanaka, Rintaro Iwata Hara, Takeshi Yamada, Kumiko Ui-Tei, Kotaro Yoshioka
Guanine bases drive acute neurotoxicity of gapmer antisense oligonucleotides after intracerebroventricular administration, which is able to be mitigated by chemical modifications of guanines without compromising silencing activity.
